feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church. One row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Матфея пресвитера (1921)»

death.note: The year the day line closes with, and the only year this calendar gives him. He is the only saint on this day dated 1921.

names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 9673, «Матфей (Александров), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank and grade words left off. The day line declines the forename and prints no surname at all, so the surname is read from the name page and not from the line. No other folder in this corpus holds this surname.
